summary_en: This study compares tebentafusp alone and tebentafusp with pembrolizumab against the investigator's choice of therapy, in adults with previously treated advanced non-ocular melanoma. How often and for how long each drug is given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the study is described as a randomized Phase 2/3 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara tebentafusp solo y tebentafusp con pembrolizumab frente a la elección del investigador, en adultos con melanoma avanzado no ocular que ya recibieron tratamiento. La frecuencia y la duración de cada medicamento no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio se describe como un estudio aleatorizado de fase 2/3.
who_for: Unresectable stage III or stage IV non-ocular melanoma
Archival tumor sample or new biopsy of a tumor lesion provided
ECOG performance status score of 0 or 1
not_for: Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Has not progressed on an anti-PD(L)1 antibody treatment
BRAF V600 mutation without prior BRAF/MEK inhibitor regimen
Active autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppressive treatment
